producer_report.summary: Added a test-only crate, athena-testkit, with write_executable(path, contents). It writes a stand-in through an `sh -c 'cat > tmp && chmod 755 tmp && mv tmp final'` child that reads the script bytes on stdin. The test process never opens the file for writing, so running it cannot hit ETXTBSY from that write. Converted every in-process stand-in write in test code to the helper: the xtask stand_in_claude and the gitleaks-version test the earlier verifier flagged, the athena-core checks.rs cargo script and reading.rs stub, the athena-agent claude.rs stand-in, the athena-cli reconcile.rs gh fake, and the athena-git snapshot.rs run.sh. The retry loop in reading.rs's check_stub is gone; claude.rs's production retry_busy is untouched. A scan test (syn-based) fails on `set_permissions`, `from_mode` or `set_mode` in test code: files under tests/, cfg(test) items, #[test] fns, and cfg(test) out-of-line modules. Planted-violation unit tests are included. The stress test uses direct io::stderr writes, which the harness does not capture, so the ETXTBSY counts show in a passing run. In my runs the in-process variant hit ETXTBSY 22 of 480 times, then 5 of 480; the helper hit 0 both times. Also added: D157 (D08 checked, stands) with its link, an athena-testkit row in the architecture crate table, shard-timings lines, and one CHANGELOG entry written from the final diff. The earlier candidate was not in my working copy, so I rebuilt it from the brief and the code.

checks_run.note: 5 lib, 6 scan, 2 stress tests pass. Stress output: 'ETXTBSY runs with write_executable: 0 of 480' and 'ETXTBSY runs with an in-process write: 22 of 480'.

criteria_check.criterion: Grep for `set_permissions` and `from_mode(0o755)` in xtask/src/main.rs, crates/athena-cli/tests/reconcile.rs, crates/athena-agent/src/claude.rs, crates/athena-core/src/checks.rs, crates/athena-core/src/reading.rs and crates/athena-git/src/snapshot.rs finds no test code that writes an executable; only production code matches. The xtask gitleaks-version test calls athena_testkit::write_executable.
criteria_check.evidence: After the edits, the only remaining hits are production code: xtask set_executable (outside the test module), and the git snapshot.rs set_write_bits and set_mode. None are in the files' test modules. The xtask test a_cached_gitleaks_is_skipped_only_when_it_reports_the_pinned_version calls athena_testkit::write_executable(&fake, "#!/bin/sh\necho 8.1.0\n"). The workspace scan test no_test_code_in_the_workspace_writes_an_executable_in_process passes.

criteria_check.criterion: The helper source in crates/athena-testkit/src/lib.rs spawns sh with the script bytes on stdin running cat to a temp file, chmod 755, then mv to the final path, waits for it, and never opens the script for writing in the test process.
criteria_check.evidence: Read lib.rs. WRITE_SCRIPT is `cat > "$1" && chmod 755 -- "$1" && mv -- "$1" "$2"`, run by `sh -c` with the bytes written to the child's piped stdin. The temp file is in the same directory, and the code calls wait_with_output. There is no File::create, fs::write or OpenOptions in the helper. Five unit tests pass.

criteria_check.evidence: Ran `cargo test -p athena-testkit` and, with --locked, `-p athena-testkit` together with athena-git, athena-agent and xtask. The scan test passes, as do a_planted_in_process_executable_write_in_a_test_module_is_flagged and a_planted_violation_in_a_scratch_workspace_is_reported_with_file_and_line. Stress output line: 'ETXTBSY runs with write_executable: 0 of 480'. The in-process count line appears in the passing output: 22 of 480 on one run, 5 of 480 on another.

open_issues: athena-core state::tests::the_job_lock_probe_sees_a_held_lock_and_creates_nothing failed once in the full athena-core lib run (state.rs:932, `assert!(!state.job_lock_held(..))`) and passes when run alone. It looks like a load-dependent flake in code I did not touch. I did not investigate its cause. It may be worth a separate job.
The scan skips crates/athena-testkit/src and crates/athena-testkit/tests/stand_in_stress.rs, whose comparison variant writes in-process on purpose. Both skips are documented in the scan test.
mistakes: The first scan-test draft used r#"..."# for a string containing "# and failed to compile; fixed with r##"..."##.
A first stress-test draft had a let-and-return that clippy would flag; I removed it.
learnings: The earlier candidate's changes were not in the working copy (it is the base commit), so everything was rebuilt from the brief.
The libtest harness does not capture direct writes through std::io::stderr(), so a passing test can still show a measurement line.
The decision-link `line` must be the line of the 'Amends D08' phrase in the new decisions.md entry. The backtest test checks it.
The workspace syn dependency is v2, but cargo also builds syn v3 for schemars_derive.
The athena-testkit scan sees proc-macro2 line numbers only with the span-locations feature, so the crate lists proc-macro2 as a dev-dependency.
desires: A way to run the whole workspace suite in under the producer time limit, and to read a persisted tool-output file.
